zh: 新组件不用重启宿主也能出现在看板上：热重载读到组件库里的新组件时，看板给它补一张卡。之前只在启动时补，改组件看得见、加组件得重启一次。
en: A new widget reaches the board without restarting the host: when a hot reload finds a widget the board has no card for, one is added. Before, that only happened at startup, so editing a widget showed up but adding one needed a restart.
